## Search Index

### Figure Description
This figure is a schematic representation of a computational workflow in quantum chemistry. It shows the process of using a Message Passing Neural Network (MPNN) to predict molecular properties, contrasting it with traditional Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations. The workflow begins with a molecular structure, which is input into both DFT and MPNN methods. The DFT method takes approximately 10^3 seconds to compute properties like energy and wave function, while the MPNN method takes about 10^-2 seconds.

### Text in Figure
- DFT
- ~10^3 seconds
- Targets: E, ω0,...
- Message Passing Neural Network
- ~10^-2 seconds
- Molecular structure (benzene ring)
